glosses: nach vorn beziehungsweise oben verlagerten Schwerpunkt habend

examples.text: Durch seinen hohen Schwerpunkt ist der Wagen sehr kopflastig.

glosses: vom Geist stark bestimmt, deutlich rational auf Kosten der Emotionen

examples.text: Er ist sehr kopflastig, und es fällt ihm schwer, sein Herz zu öffnen.
Von der Feier kam sie wiedereinmal sehr kopflastig nach Hause.

glosses: überproportional viele Personen in leitenden Positionen eines Unternehmens habend

examples.text: Selbst jeder Controller hat noch einen Assistenten, was die Firma letztlich sehr kopflastig macht.

translations.source_sense_description: nach vorn beziehungsweise oben verlagerten Schwerpunkt habend

glosses: having a high centre of gravity, and liable to topple

examples.text: Legion: Your new platform is inefficient. It has low-volume hydraulics and is top-heavy.

glosses: having an excessive number of administrators or managers
Having a significant portion of the plan assets allocated to key employees to the detriment of lower-wage employees.

examples.text: A defined benefit plan is top-heavy if[…] the present value of the accrued benefits (PVAB) under the plan for the key employees exceeds 60 percent of the PVAB under the plan for all employees.

glosses: having a disproportionately large upper body, especially the bust

examples.text: "My figure is topheavy, and I always thought a woman with a large bust had to look mature. Now I know better." An all-in-one girdle is a lifesaver for women like Miss B.
The top-heavy woman finished her whisky. She left fatty finger marks on the glass.
He who confines his drink to the same level as that of the poor unreasoning soul-less animals, who never take too much and are never “top-heavy,” cannot avoid irritation.
